headline: Hitman: Codename 47
title: Hitman Codename 47 Facts | Agent 47 Begins | Classic Games
video_script: Hitman: Codename 47 was released in November two thousand, developed by Danish studio IO Interactive and published by Eidos Interactive for Windows. You play Agent 47, a genetically engineered assassin. It was the first game to use the Glacier engine, which IO Interactive still builds on, and it was an early game with ragdoll physics. Silent or loud? Comment below!
description: Hitman Codename 47 released November 2000 by IO Interactive and Eidos. Sources: Wikipedia, IO Interactive, Metacritic.
joke: Agent 47 always has the best disguise, even at the worst parties.
